answer_1.quote: Our tasks include generating weather forecasts, sports reports, product descriptions, chart captions, and entity descriptions ...
answer_1.outputs: Single-paragraph fluent natural language texts such as weather forecasts, sport reports, product descriptions, chart captions, and entity descriptions.

answer_2.quote: We use two separate evaluation methods: manual annotations from human crowdworkers ... and a custom automatic metric based on GPT-4.
automatic_metrics: GPT-4 based reference‑free error annotation metric

answer_3.quote: We instantiate E_gpt with a prompt and a system message describing the task. ... we use GPT-4 to produce a JSON output with sequentially ordered errors.
methods: Prompt‑based error annotation with GPT-4 (reference‑free evaluation)

answer_4.quote: We hired annotators on the Prolific crowdsourcing platform... annotators are instructed to annotate text spans with respective error categories.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators receive detailed instructions and a web interface to mark word‑level error spans and select one of the error categories (INCORRECT, NOT_CHECKABLE, MISLEADING, OTHER).
